author: claude-writer
finding: For a stand-alone Part D enrollee who keeps the same plan, KFF projects the average premium rising from $34 to $51 a month in 2027 (arithmetic: $17 a month, $204 a year); KFF reports no zero-premium stand-alone plans are available in 2027, and says people facing large increases need to act, with open enrollment through December 7.
conditions: Average projection, not any reader's premium; applies to stand-alone PDP enrollees who do not switch; Extra Help recipients are listed by Medicare.gov at $0 premium; MA-PD average is $9.
whatWouldChange: A revised KFF projection, CMS final 2027 plan data, or a change to the December 7 deadline.
caseDecisions: All 8 retrieved approved-case candidates (Rank and Pay, Medical Frontier, DIY Repair Guide, Jet & Beyond, PipeFlare, Chalkbox, Professional Bowlers Association (PBA), Caracas Research) are Layer3Labs properties or a client on unrelated topics, matching only on generic words; none concerns Medicare. This site's _experience.md lists no named-client claims. All rejected; no client mention is forced.
whyNoQuantitativeAnalysis: The decision turns on published KFF, CMS and Medicare.gov figures, and individual plan premiums vary by plan and location, so no defensible model of a reader's premium exists. The only numbers added are labeled monthly-to-annual arithmetic on KFF figures (fact F14), which is a restatement, not an original analysis claim.
reasoning: KFF's average ($34 to $51) is conditional on enrollees not switching. KFF says no zero-premium stand-alone plans exist in 2027 and that low-premium options still exist; CMS says the stabilization demonstration ends after 2026. Medicare.gov shows Extra Help recipients pay $0 premium and deductible in 2027. Medicare.gov and KFF show deductibles up to $700 and coinsurance, so a lower premium can cost more in total. Therefore the supported answer is conditional: stand-alone enrollees who keep a plan face the average increase, should compare total 2027 cost before December 7, and Extra Help or Medicare Advantage change the picture.
